about_the_game:
🧭 Tales of Miravia – Demo

Embark on the first steps of a magical adventure.

In this Tales of Miravia demo, dive into the world of Miravia and meet the enigmatic Zerax, the first playable character. Explore the peaceful Lubina Village, venture into the mysterious Mirden Forest, and face the very first boss of the story.

⚔️ What’s included in this demo?

  • You control Zerax, a warrior with a dark and mysterious past.

  • Explore Mirden Forest and face off against the first boss of the game.

  • Experience the combat system, with events that alter the strategy of every battle.

  • Discover dialogues and chests with random rewards, as well as key narrative elements.

🚫 Note: This demo does not include minigames or access to other playable characters.

🎯 This content is subject to change as development progresses!

📝 Add Tales of Miravia to your wishlist and join us on this ever-evolving adventure!
